label: Sense splits for the one dependence order: SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 and PRIOR_4 (#1926)
summary: #1926 phase 3, the two sense tests left by the one-dependence-order slice (docs/notes/one-dependence-order.md, section 'Sense splits'; specs/dependence-order-senses.toml). (i) New analyst sense SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 (definition 57348ddc, CausesBeingAsCaused: here and now c efficiently causes x's being, per se as caused, with the PER_SE_5 primitive AsCaused). e8664ab8 restated on it (bb7e4426) escapes the hand-and-stick case; it follows from no self-causation 8b2561cd and the present-cause bridge 622dbf36. The existential no-regress premise 87aa978c follows from ea251340 and bb7e4426, so it joins the one order (82cfaf26 -> fd12ad3d -> ea251340 -> 87aa978c). With the open sense bridge e81ec2fe (SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 into SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3) it also follows from 97f5850f and bb7e4426 from e8664ab8: the existential relation is narrower and its premises weaker; without the sense bridge they are independent, and secundaSplitLimit gives a Nat interpretation where the existential order holds while 97f5850f, the mover regress and e8664ab8 fail. Source finding (passages aba37900, a34be6a3, f74e1b94 materialized and read): the secunda via and ad 7 do not restrict the per se series to causes of being; ad 7's examples are movers and generation (q.104 a.1: a same-species generator causes becoming only); the existential reading is an analyst narrowing, attribution deferred. (ii) PRIOR_4 already existed (f4365b55). 86efed1a is falsified on its bound PRIOR_1 by hand-and-stick; its warrant belongs to PRIOR_4. The PRIOR_4 bridge among actual concreta bd305511 and AGWF give PRIOR_4 well-founded among actual concreta (522506d1), with no irreflexivity premise. The only consumer of d85de8e1 (e229bb2c) needs PRIOR_1 through e078f07b; priorityConsumerLimit certifies that the PRIOR_4 member holds while d85de8e1, 42890b45 and 86efed1a fail. Provisional judgment: the one order is an order of being; the prima and secunda via regress premises consumed on the root routes (d85de8e1, 97f5850f) do not share it. frontier-diff: no change. Tooling finding: lean4export merges a definition body of shape forall y x, R y x -> S y x with the implicit-binder body of Subrelation, and Comparator then reports a value mismatch (seen for PerSeMoverLinkIsPerSeCauseLinkReading when the Solution uses Subrelation.accessible); worked around by omitting that conjunct from SecundaSplitLimit.
blocker: Open: every bridge (bb7e4426, 622dbf36, e81ec2fe, bd305511) and 82cfaf26 remain open premises; bd305511 keeps the necessary-condition scope condition (oxygen and flame) and depends on natural versus absolute possibility in DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT; no root route consumes 87aa978c or 522506d1 (connection plan: a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 instance of the secunda via wired to the De ente root interface; PRIOR_4 siblings of the 86efed1a consumers); the source-free global-structure rival targets AGWF and so every member of the order; the lean4export binder-info merge is a lane C tooling defect.
